title: Lively Snappy Peruvian Apricot Suspiro Limeno
description: A refreshing and invigorating Peruvian dessert featuring apricot and pickle, perfect for a post-workout snack, with a macrobiotic-friendly twist on the traditional suspiro limeno.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine dulce de leche, apricot jam, and pickle juice, and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture is smooth and warm.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in sea salt and vanilla extract.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, whip the evaporated milk until it becomes stiff and holds its shape.
Fold the cooled dulce de leche mixture into the whipped evaporated milk until well combined.
Gently stir in the chopped canned apricot.
Spoon the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld and the mixture to chill.
Serve the Lively Snappy Peruvian Apricot Suspiro Limeno chilled, garnished with additional chopped apricot if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
